name: com.midmanstudio.patterns
description: Generic, engine-independent design pattern building blocks for Unity 2022.3+. Command (undo/redo history, grouped and merged commands, composite commands, deferred command queue), State (stack-based state machine), Event Queue (deferred typed events), Dependency Injection (service locator and a factory-based container), and Broker Chain (central broker running priority-ordered handlers over a query, with a stat sheet for buffs and modifiers), Dirty Flag, Double Buffer, Flyweight, Prototype, Type Object, Data Locality, Spatial Partition, Decorator, Factory, and a fixed-step Game Loop). No dependencies; Singleton, pooling and immediate events live in the utilities package.
